comment: Easy to understand, doesn't expect too much from her students. She definitely wants her students to learn, though they are unmotivated on the whole. Not the greatest at explaining grammar, might want to consult the book (or Peebles) for that.
She had no idea what she was doing. I just got more confused listening to her explain grammar. She is very nice, and you can tell she wants you to learn, but the class was a waste of time.
She's very easy and doesn't expect much from you. She's easygoing and cares about you.
Wonderful, caring professor.  She will help if you only ask.  She makes Spanish interesting and come alive.  I majored in Spanish and studied abroad because of her inspiration.  Dulce es fantastica!

Very, very nice lady. Hard to understand. Class has a lot of papers and you have to do 20 hrs of community service. I'm not sure how hard she'll grade us, but she seems somewhat easy. She loves freedom and Cuba.

Shes very nice but she's very scattered. You're never sure what she wants you to do but you can basically just do something remotely close to the assignement & turn it in late and she doesnt care. Her tests can be a little hard but as long as you understand the material, you should do ok. Lots of compositions on movies but they're only 1 page.

UNCLEAR! Incredibly hard quizzes/exams since SHE DOES NOT TEACH. Compositions every week, sometimes twice per week, which isn't bad, but tests are impossible. Movies/stories/poems in Spanish are assigned about nothing at all. This is NOT an easy class anymore, like I was told. Be prepared to work and study a lot to make up for no guidance/teaching!
Dulce is candy.  Take her, sit back and enjoy.
easy prof.  super-nice, even invited the class to her house for dinner where she cooked the best cuban food i've ever had.

Dulce was a very easy teacher but very unclear in what she wanted the class to do.  She was always late and disorganized.  She's very nice and seems airheaded but be careful beacuse she's smarter than she comes across.

For comments that they could not understand her, obviously cannot understand extremely articulate Spanish and should go back to intro hs classes.Mentioning her beloved Cuba gets her off track and this often hinders the lesson plan.No structured notes and this absent-mindedness upsets many of the students.Modifies dept tests,put "modelos" on final.

will not understand one word you say to her - she just nods and says yes - class is easy and attendance does not matter, but the lack of structure and clarity makes the everyone in the class somewhat uneasy

Horrible...nice lady, but one word comes to mind: incoherent.  No one understood her, she doesn't understand us.  No structure in the class, no one knew what the hell was going on.  Didn't learn anything even remotely useful.
Horrible teacher. Most of the time does not understand you when you ask a question. Is always late and does not take teaching this class seriously.

Easy teacher. Take 221 with her if you want an A and do not want to go on b/c you do not learn as much as with another teacher. Shows up late to class often. Nice personality. Mention Cuba to get on her good side. Does not check Quia (online homework). Assigns a lot of homework but doesn't check it.
Dulce is a very easy teacher. The problem i that you dont learn much in her class. She is helpful outside of the classs. It is a class to take for a grade, not to learn.
Easy professor, generally fun, but occasionally boring classes.
